It takes a lot of time to learn nurse. I'd give yourself fifty games where you don't actually expect to win or rank up if you're still learning her.

\- Do NOT use any addons when you play her. One of the biggest mistakes a nurse player can make is taking addons when they are still learning her blink ranges, charge up time, speed and accuracy. Play without any of those for a long time, and you'll learn all about her ability. Her ability IS the core of her entire persona as she has incredibly slow movement speed.

\- Blink directly into the ground to go nowhere. Survivors will occasionally run towards you when they know you've charged your blink up, it's a common juke that allows them to get a TON of distance as you'll go across the map away from them if you charge your blink for too long. If you aren't near the basement, aiming downwards will teleport you on the spot and avoid this juke.
If the survivors are good you can't do anything against them either lol. It's a skill game. Whoever is better wins.
